description: Paid ($0.01 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Algorand or Stellar, in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger or in USD₮0 on X Layer): call this before your agent buys, holds or accepts a token, when it needs one answer to act on. Send tokenAddress (an EVM token contract 0x..., a Solana mint, an XRPL CURRENCY.rIssuer or an Algorand asset id) and chain (default base). Get back everything token_verdict returns (green/orange/red, grade SAFE/CAUTION/RISKY/AVOID, reason codes, one-line summary, market data), plus decision (buy, small_only or do_not_buy, from the grade), take (one or two plain sentences for whoever is about to buy), sell_check (can_sell yes, limited, no or unknown, one entry per check with its source; on Base a sell transfer into the token's pool is simulated on chain, simulated true only when it ran; missing data is unknown, never no) and share (a signed link to a page and a 1200x630 card, to show a person). Do not buy on do_not_buy or when can_sell is no. Same as POST /v1/token/verdict. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

chain.description: Chain the token lives on (default base)

tokenAddress.description: Solana mint address (base58), EVM token contract (0x...), an XRPL token as CURRENCY.rIssuer (e.g. RLUSD.rMxCKbEDwqr76QuheSUMdEGf4B9xJ8m5De), or an Algorand asset id (e.g. 31566704)

name: token_check

accepts.description: Only on an unpaid call: the x402 payment options

decision.description: From the grade: SAFE buy, CAUTION small_only, RISKY or AVOID do_not_buy

anyOf.description: Why the verdict is what it is

code.description: Reason code, e.g. SPENDER_FLAGGED, UNLIMITED_ALLOWANCE, TOKEN_HONEYPOT

subject.description: The address or item the reason is about (null or absent when it is about the whole request)

anyOf.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the verdict to your arguments

simulated.description: true only when a sell transfer into the token's pool was simulated on chain

sell_check.description: Can a holder sell it back? One entry per check, with its source

share.description: A signed link to a page and a 1200x630 card for this verdict (null without a receipt signer)

take.description: One or two plain sentences for someone about to buy

anyOf.description: green: go ahead; orange: ask the user; red: do not sign or buy

verdict.description: green: go ahead; orange: ask the user; red: do not sign or buy (absent on the payment requirement)

title: Token check before buying ($0.01 via x402)
